title: Cancellation Refund Terms — Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships
content:
Two figures govern refunds when a Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships membership is cancelled: the number of calendar days after the start date within which a cancelled membership with no visit is refunded in full, and whether a cancellation after that window refunds the unused full months.

| Membership | Full-refund window after the start date (calendar days) | Unused full months refunded on a cancellation after the window |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | 30 | No |
| Summit Club Individual | 30 | No |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | 30 | No |
| Summit Club Executive | 30 | No |
| Summit Club Corporate | 30 | Yes |
| Summit Club Lifetime | 30 | No |

## Distinguishing the memberships

- The full-refund window is 30 calendar days after the start date on every membership in the range.
- Summit Club Corporate is the only membership on which a cancellation after the window refunds the unused full months. On the other five memberships it does not.
